targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rotation_window) as value FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(last_rotation_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') as rotation_window, COUNT(*) as rotation_count FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND last_rotation_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND last_rotation_at IS NOT NULL AND location IN ($location) GROUP BY rotation_window HAVING rotation_count >= 5) cycles;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) as value FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND last_rotation_at IS NOT NULL AND last_rotation_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AND location IN ($location)

SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM proxy_requests pr JOIN proxies p ON pr.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE pr.timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND p.active = true AND p.last_rotation_at IS NOT NULL AND pr.timestamp BETWEEN DATE_SUB(p.last_rotation_at, INTERVAL 2 MINUTE) AND DATE_ADD(p.last_rotation_at, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AND pr.ip_changed = true AND p.location IN ($location)

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(rotation_window, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec, rotation_count FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(last_rotation_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') as rotation_window, COUNT(*) as rotation_count FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND $__timeFilter(last_rotation_at) AND last_rotation_at IS NOT NULL AND location IN ($location) GROUP BY rotation_window HAVING rotation_count >= 1) cycles ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(pr.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec, COUNT(*) as total_tests, COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) as successful_tests FROM proxy_requests pr JOIN proxies p ON pr.proxy_id = p.device_id WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp) AND p.active = true AND p.last_rotation_at IS NOT NULL AND pr.timestamp BETWEEN DATE_SUB(p.last_rotation_at, INTERVAL 2 MINUTE) AND DATE_ADD(p.last_rotation_at, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AND p.location IN ($location) GROUP BY time_sec ORDER BY time_sec

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(rotation_window, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as cycle_time, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) as proxies_rotated, COUNT(*) as total_rotations FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(last_rotation_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') as rotation_window, device_id FROM proxies WHERE active = true AND $__timeFilter(last_rotation_at) AND last_rotation_at IS NOT NULL AND location IN ($location)) rotations GROUP BY rotation_window ORDER BY cycle_time DESC LIMIT 20

list.name: location
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT location FROM proxies WHERE location IS NOT NULL
